story.title: The Stopped Clock
story.intro: At midnight the Great Clock of Clockwork Square stopped: the Eclipse Warden tore out its Heart of Time and fled to a sealed sanctum above the Fallen Observatory. Until the Heart returns, the night will never end. Talk to the Master Cartographer in the square to begin your quest.
story.victory: The Heart of Time beats again! The Great Clock chimes, dawn breaks over the city and your name is carved on its golden dial. You have won the game!

loc.square.name: Clockwork Square
loc.square.description: Brass clocks hang silent above a dark square; the Great Clock's hands are frozen at midnight. A cartographer waits near a fountain.

loc.market.name: Moonlight Market
loc.market.description: Shops crowd the lantern-lit arcade. North, an iron gate with a copper lock blocks the way to the old forge.

loc.library.name: The Silent Library
loc.library.description: Dusty books hum with trapped memories.

loc.garden.name: Glass Garden
loc.garden.description: Bioluminescent vines glow beneath an immense dome. Healing herbs grow between the panes.

loc.tower.name: East Watchtower
loc.tower.description: The ranger watches the marsh through a cracked telescope. Stairs lead north to the old observatory.

loc.forest.name: Whispering Forest
loc.forest.description: Ancient trees bend to listen to travelers. Yellow eyes glint between the trunks.

loc.marsh.name: Murkfen Marsh
loc.marsh.description: Green mist rises above black water. Something moves in the reeds.

loc.harbor.name: Old Harbor
loc.harbor.description: Silent boats creak beside the black-tide docks. A soaked figure walks the pier.

loc.tavern.name: Copper Kettle Tavern
loc.tavern.description: A warm hearth and the smell of freshly baked bread welcome you. A copper key hangs behind the counter.

loc.forge.name: Forgotten Forge
loc.forge.description: An abandoned forge still burns with blue flame. A ghostly smith hammers at the anvil.

loc.ruins.name: Fallen Observatory
loc.ruins.description: Broken constellations are painted on crumbling stone. A sealed door with an empty lens socket leads north.

loc.sanctum.name: Eclipse Sanctum
loc.sanctum.description: A dome of black glass where the stolen Heart of Time pulses with pale light.

item.map_fragment.name: Old Map Fragment
item.map_fragment.description: Part of a chart of the coast. Tiny handwriting covers its back.

item.copper_key.name: Copper Key
item.copper_key.description: A small ornate key. It opens the gate of the old forge.

item.silver_compass.name: Silver Compass
item.silver_compass.description: A compass that points toward lost stories.

item.herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.herbs.description: Pungent leaves from the garden. USE them to recover 35 HP.

item.rusty_sword.name: Rusty Sword
item.rusty_sword.description: An old sword, still sharp enough (+4 attack while carried).

item.bread.name: Loaf of Bread
item.bread.description: A freshly baked loaf. USE it to recover 20 HP.

item.lantern.name: Oil Lantern
item.lantern.description: A lantern to light the road.

item.iron_shield.name: Iron Shield
item.iron_shield.description: A sturdy shield from a forgotten smithy (blocks 4 damage per hit while carried).

item.star_lens.name: Star Lens
item.star_lens.description: A crystal lens that focuses starlight. It fits the sealed door of the observatory.

item.heart_of_time.name: Heart of Time
item.heart_of_time.description: The glowing heart of the Great Clock. It must return to the Master Cartographer.

npc.cartographer.name: Master Cartographer
dialogue: The Great Clock has stopped and the night will not end. Help the Marsh Ranger, the City Guard and the Ghost Smith; come back when the Eclipse Warden has fallen.
Tick, tock... the city owes you its morning, hero.

npc.guard.name: City Guard
dialogue: Keep the peace, traveler. The Marsh Ranger in the East Watchtower needs help before I can trust you.
The roads are safe again thanks to you.

npc.merchant.name: Market Merchant
dialogue: The old forge north of my stall is locked. The Tavern Keeper keeps its Copper Key.
They say a ghost smith still works the blue flame of the forge.
Healing Herbs from the Glass Garden have saved many a fool who fought the Warden.

npc.librarian.name: Old Librarian
npc.librarian.description: An attentive keeper of rare books.
dialogue: Knowledge is the real treasure. Bring the Cartographer what he needs first.
Read well, fight well.

npc.ranger.name: Marsh Ranger
npc.ranger.description: A weathered hunter with a green cloak.
dialogue: Talk to the Master Cartographer first; I only trust those who know the way.
The night is over. Rest, hero.

npc.innkeeper.name: Tavern Keeper
dialogue: Rest by the fire; everyone is welcome. Take the Copper Key if you need the old forge.
The harbor sleeps peacefully now. Drinks are on the house!

npc.smith.name: Ghost Smith
npc.smith.description: A translucent blacksmith who never stopped working.
dialogue: Clang... clang... Starsteel is not for everyone. Free the Star Lens from the bandit first, then come back.
Your starsteel will never dull.

npc.wolf.name: Shadow Wolf
npc.wolf.description: A wolf made of living shadow.
dialogue: Grrrr...

npc.wraith.name: Marsh Wraith
npc.wraith.description: An angry ghost wrapped in mist.
dialogue: Leave this place!

npc.drowned.name: Drowned Sailor
npc.drowned.description: A sailor who never came home, dripping with black water.
dialogue: The tide... took... everything...

npc.bandit.name: Ruin Bandit
npc.bandit.description: A cutpurse lurking behind a pillar, a crystal lens hanging from his belt.
dialogue: Your coins or your life!

npc.warden.name: Eclipse Warden
npc.warden.description: A towering knight of black glass holding the stolen Heart of Time.
dialogue: The night is mine. Your blades cannot touch me.

quest.compass.name: A True North
quest.compass.description: Bring the Silver Compass from the library to the Master Cartographer. Use TALK to deliver it.
quest.compass.offer: Before we chase the Eclipse Warden I must chart the way. Bring me the Silver Compass from the Silent Library, north then east of here.
quest.compass.reminder: The Silver Compass waits in the Silent Library, north then east of here. Bring it and TALK to me.
quest.compass.complete: Thank you! With this compass I can see the Warden's trail: it leads east, past the Watchtower. Go and help the Marsh Ranger.

quest.wraith.name: The Marsh Wraith
quest.wraith.description: Defeat the Marsh Wraith south of the Whispering Forest.
quest.wraith.offer: The Marsh Wraith threatens our village. Will you stop it?
quest.wraith.reminder: The Marsh Wraith haunts Murkfen Marsh, south of the Whispering Forest. The Rusty Sword here may help.

quest.bandit.name: Thief of Stars
quest.bandit.description: Defeat the Ruin Bandit in the Fallen Observatory (north of the East Watchtower) and take the Star Lens he drops.
quest.bandit.offer: A bandit stole the Star Lens from the observatory. Without it nobody can open the sealed door that leads to the Warden. Defeat him!
quest.bandit.reminder: The Ruin Bandit hides in the Fallen Observatory, north of the East Watchtower. He hits hard: the Iron Shield in the old forge would help.

quest.starsteel.name: Starsteel
quest.starsteel.description: Bring the Rusty Sword from the East Watchtower to the Ghost Smith in the Forgotten Forge to have your weapon reforged in starsteel.
quest.starsteel.offer: Only starsteel can wound the Eclipse Warden. Bring me the Rusty Sword from the East Watchtower and I will reforge your weapon.
quest.starsteel.reminder: The Rusty Sword lies in the East Watchtower. Bring it and TALK to me.
quest.starsteel.complete: Thank you! The blue flame roars and your weapon turns to starsteel (+8 attack). Now the Warden can bleed. Tell the Marsh Ranger.

quest.warden.name: The Eclipse Warden
quest.warden.description: Open the sealed door north of the Fallen Observatory with the Star Lens and defeat the Eclipse Warden.
quest.warden.offer: Your blade shines with starsteel. The Warden waits behind the sealed door north of the Fallen Observatory; the Star Lens will open it. End this night!
quest.warden.reminder: Carry the Star Lens north of the Fallen Observatory. Take Healing Herbs and the Iron Shield with you.

quest.heart.name: Midnight's End
quest.heart.description: Take the Heart of Time dropped by the Eclipse Warden back to the Master Cartographer and TALK to him to restart the Great Clock.
quest.heart.offer: The Warden has fallen! Bring me the Heart of Time and we will set it back into the Great Clock.
quest.heart.reminder: The Heart of Time lies where the Warden fell, in the Eclipse Sanctum. Bring it and TALK to me.
quest.heart.complete: Thank you! The Heart of Time slides into place... tick... tock... the Great Clock chimes again!

quest.notes.name: The Astronomer's Notes
quest.notes.description: Side quest: bring the Old Map Fragment from Clockwork Square to the Old Librarian.
quest.notes.offer: That Old Map Fragment lying in the square belonged to the last astronomer. Its back hides notes about the Warden. Bring it to me!
quest.notes.reminder: The Old Map Fragment lies in Clockwork Square. Bring it and TALK to me.
quest.notes.complete: Thank you! These notes show where the Warden's armour is thin. Your blows strike harder (+3 attack).

quest.tide.name: Restless Tide
quest.tide.description: Side quest: defeat the Drowned Sailor who haunts the Old Harbor.
quest.tide.offer: A drowned sailor rises from the harbor every night and scares my customers. Put him to rest and I will pay you well.
quest.tide.reminder: The Drowned Sailor walks the pier of the Old Harbor, west of the square.
